title: Ekta Nagar's Glow Garden and 1.5-Crore-Light Display Draw Diwali-Week Families
excerpt: An upgraded Unity Glow Garden, a 530-metre illuminated stretch and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel anchor Ekta Prakash Parv at the Statue of Unity, while Bharat Parv runs until November 15 and the statue stays open on Monday, November 9.
body:
• Ekta Nagar's Ekta Prakash Parv illumination includes a 530-metre lit stretch along Valley of Flowers Road and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel, using more than 1.5 crore LED lights, according to IANS.
  • The Unity Glow Garden, a 3.61-acre night theme park of light installations and optical illusions, was upgraded as part of a Rs 426.71 crore package of Statue of Unity projects inaugurated on October 31.
  • Bharat Parv 2026 runs at Ekta Nagar until November 15, and the Statue of Unity will remain open on Monday, November 9, for Diwali-period families, though the viewing gallery will be closed that day.
  • Diwali itself falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026 — plan the lights for after sunset, and check official pages before travelling because the official festival page calls its timings and programme tentative.

For families heading to the Statue of Unity this Diwali, the main event begins after dark. Ekta Nagar, in Gujarat's Narmada district, is running overlapping festivals of light through the Diwali period: an upgraded Unity Glow Garden, the Ekta Prakash Parv illumination spread across the campus, and Bharat Parv, a national culture festival that continues until November 15.

A garden built for night tourism

The Unity Glow Garden is a theme park spread over 3.61 acres, with a glimmering array of installations, figures and optical illusions, according to the Prime Minister's official site, which describes it as an invitation for tourists to experience night tourism. The garden was upgraded this season: its upgradation was part of the package of 31 tourism and infrastructure projects worth Rs 426.71 crore that Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated or laid foundation stones for at Ekta Nagar on October 31, according to IANS.

1.5 crore lights along the Valley of Flowers road

The larger illumination is Ekta Prakash Parv, which IANS describes as an illumination festival celebrating India's unity, diversity, cultural heritage and progress. Its attractions include a 530-metre illuminated stretch along Valley of Flowers Road, themed "From Ancient India to Modern India," and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel showcasing the cultures, architecture, folk dances, handicrafts and lifestyles of the country's four regions. More than 1.5 crore LED lights have been used for the displays, with artworks created by artists from across the country, IANS reported.

The official Ekta Prakash Parv page says last year's edition lit approximately 7.6 km of Ekta Nagar, from Ekta Dwar to the Statue of Unity, with a dynamic light and sound show at the Sardar Sarovar Dam, and drew nearly 5 lakh visitors. It says the festival returns in 2026 on a grander scale for a period of about three months starting in mid-October, and it notes that timings and the programme schedule are tentative and may change, advising visitors to check official communications for the latest updates.

Bharat Parv runs through the Diwali week

Alongside the lights, Bharat Parv 2026 is under way near the Statue of Unity until November 15. Organised by the Union Ministry of Tourism in collaboration with Gujarat Tourism, the festival has reportedly drawn more than 25,000 visitors in its first three days, according to The CSR Journal. Its theme is "Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat," with pavilions of regional handicrafts and handlooms, 25 stalls serving regional dishes, and folk music and dance performances every evening.

For the Diwali period specifically, The CSR Journal reported that the Statue of Unity will remain open on Monday, November 9, to give families an additional opportunity to visit during the holiday period, although the viewing gallery will be closed that day. Diwali itself falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026.

Plan Your Visit

  • Dates: Bharat Parv runs until Sunday, November 15, 2026; Ekta Prakash Parv's 2026 edition runs for about three months from mid-October, according to its official page
  • Venue: Statue of Unity campus, Ekta Nagar, Narmada district, Gujarat
  • Monday note: The Statue of Unity will remain open on Monday, November 9, 2026, but the viewing gallery will be closed that day
  • Admission: Not stated in the sources for the glow garden or the light festival — check the official Statue of Unity website before travelling
  • Timings: The official festival page says timings and the programme schedule are tentative and may change
  • Official page: Ekta Prakash Parv — Rashtriya Ekta Diwas

For a diaspora family combining a Gujarat trip with the festival, the practical shape of a visit is simple: spend the day on the campus and at Bharat Parv's food and craft pavilions, then stay for the illuminated stretch, the Glow Tunnel and the Glow Garden after sunset — the part of Ekta Nagar that was built, and this year upgraded, specifically for the night.
